_doc: Sects & Missions, the member's side (design/gdd/sects.md rules 19-22, 25; Formulas F10, F12, F13). standing_events: F10's e values (a gain is smoothed by 1 - St/100 when St >= 0; a fall is taken in full). desertion: the fall and the ceiling standing is then set to (F10). ally_share: share of a fall the sect's allies and vassals take (F10; none exist until pacts and vassalage are built). hostile_threshold: Quests hostile_threshold, the standing at or below which the sect treats the player as hostile and will not sell or recruit (F11). recruit_line_base / recruit_line_per_dial: the recruit line 20 - 10 x Recruitment (F11). default_dials: PROVISIONAL stance dials (0-4) every sect uses until the stance dials of rule 12 are built. join_realm_floor: lowest realm index a sect recruits (rule 20). rank_names: how each rank of the ladder (world_generation.json sects.rank_ladder) is shown. contribution_per_cash: F12 c_share, contribution per linh thach of a sect mission's cash. promotion: F13 gates of a great sect for each rank reached by promotion (realm index, contribution spent, standing); the head seat is not reached by promotion (rule 28: an open seat or a trial).
